q: Structural stability of a diffeomorphism T means that all diffeomorphisms C¹-close to T are:
exp: Structural stability: there is a C¹ neighborhood U of T such that every S ∈ U is topologically conjugate to T. Peixoto's theorem characterises structurally stable vector fields on compact surfaces; in higher dimensions, Axiom A + strong transversality condition (Smale) is sufficient.
